features.name: Local HTTP server
features.detail: Single-file stdlib HTTP server bound to localhost:9876 (--port override). Serves the HTML browser and ~50 /api/* routes; threaded for SSE streaming.

features.name: REST/JSON endpoints
features.detail: /api/schema, /api/schemas, /api/folders, /api/settings, /api/extract, /api/re-extract, /api/import, /api/chat, /api/nl2sql, /api/run-sql, /api/table-data, /api/compare-chat, and more.

features.name: SSE streaming pipe
features.detail: Streams Ollama /api/chat and /api/generate, plus OpenRouter / direct-API chat completions, to the browser as Server-Sent Events with per-provider delta parsing.

features.name: Read-only SQL guard
features.detail: Rejects non-SELECT statements and enforces a row cap (<= 1000) before any query executes against a live connection.

features.name: Driver install allow-list
features.detail: Only the registered DB-driver pip packages may be installed via the UI; arbitrary pip installs are blocked.

features.name: Login auth & sessions
features.detail: users + sessions tables (SQLite); HMAC-hashed passwords, token-based sessions, first-run admin seed (Admin / MapSnap, must_change_pw).

features.name: Role & tab permission model
features.detail: auth_mode=login; roles viewer/contributor/builder/analyst/admin map to tab sets + feature flags; per-user features_override can only narrow.

features.name: Auth gate on protected routes
features.detail: Public paths whitelisted; everything else requires a valid session; admin-only gate for /api/users CRUD and policy raises.

features.name: Multi-engine extractors
features.detail: SqliteExtractor, PostgresExtractor, MySqlExtractor, OracleExtractor, plus ChromaExtractor / QdrantExtractor for vector stores; shared _wire_fks relationship wiring.

features.name: SQL Server live extract
features.detail: Reads sys.tables/views/columns/foreign_keys via pyodbc into a schema.json compatible with the whole build pipeline; optional --module-map.

features.name: CSV schema import
features.detail: Auto-detects Objects / Columns / PK / FK CSV roles by header; rebuilds schema.json when direct connection is unavailable.

features.name: DDL schema import
features.detail: Parses CREATE TABLE / DDL exports into the same schema.json object model.

features.name: Soft (inferred) FK detection
features.detail: Infers relationships from column-name conventions for schemas that declare no formal FKs (e.g. OnBase); adds soft edges to schema.json.

features.name: Browser HTML builder
features.detail: Generates the single-page schema_browser.html from schema.json + sidecars (columns / FK-in / FK-out / diagram / data / chat / compare tabs).

features.name: System fingerprinting
features.detail: Matches table-name signatures to identify the source system (onbase, jenzabar, peoplesoft, banner, sap, epic, blackbaud, dynamics365) and load its domain pack.

features.name: Egress guardrail
features.detail: Framework-free, portable single chokepoint: blocks cloud egress under local_only, scrubs regulated values, strips LOCAL_ONLY-sentinel spans, logs every decision; fail-safe to local_only.

features.name: Guardrail wiring at cloud pipes
features.detail: guard_cloud_egress wraps the only cloud egress points; local Ollama, local embeddings, and /api/run-sql are unaffected.

features.name: Per-profile AI policy meta
features.detail: Read/written via /api/schema-meta with a lock guard; surfaced on /api/schema; global default_data_policy in connection.json.

features.name: enrich.py chain
features.detail: Event-driven (extract / doc_import / config_import), db_type dispatch, idempotent via source-hash, best-effort (always exit 0); wired into build_sequences + /api/extract + /api/re-extract + upload flows.

features.name: Enrichment status sidecar
features.detail: Per-profile progress record for inline + background layers; surfaced as a UI badge.

features.name: Annotation builder
features.detail: Structural + curated (not an LLM pass) per-table purpose/role/joins; runs inline on extract; built for ONBASE13_POC (2,325 tables).

features.name: Annotations injected into prompts
features.detail: Per-retrieved-table purpose line injected into both chat and NL->SQL prompts, closing the Layer-2 gap; eval-confirmed on live gemma.

features.name: Live OnBase catalog builder
features.detail: Reads hsi.doctype + hsi.keytypetable live over SQL into BU_Catalog.json (120 DocTypes + 106 keyword types for ONBASE13_POC).

features.name: Curated config catalog builder
features.detail: Parses OnBase .expk/.spk Studio packages into the same BU_Catalog.json shape; consumed by catalog_loader.

features.name: Catalog loader + prompt block
features.detail: Resolves business names (e.g. 'Check Image' id=29) and emits a CATALOG HITS block with join guidance into the chat prompt.

features.name: profile_schema.py
features.detail: Read-only, capped (TOP-N, blob-skip), engine-agnostic profiler: row_count, lookup/fact kind, per-column distinct/null%/min/max/sample/semantic_type; PII auto-detect writes ai.column_classes + masks samples. Verified on ONBASE13_POC (300 tables / 2,306 cols, 6 PII columns).

features.name: Profile block egress safety
features.detail: Injects masked samples wrapped in a LOCAL_ONLY sentinel reaching only local models; guardrail strips the span before any cloud egress. Needs the elevated QI_MapSnap restart to go live.

features.name: Semantic index core
features.detail: One local nomic-embed-text (768-d) embedding per table synthesized from sidecars into a local ChromaDB .index/; idempotent via combined sidecar hash; ONBASE13_POC indexed (2,325 tables). Needs restart for the server-side blend.

features.name: Hybrid retrieval blend
features.detail: Blends keyword scoring with semantic matches round-robin after the OnBase spine, with pure-keyword fallback when no index / Ollama down. Needs restart to activate server-side.

features.name: Verified-query library
features.detail: record(q,sql) on successful /api/run-sql; find_similar() ranks by stemmed Jaccard; closest examples injected into NL->SQL + chat prompts. Self-improving, local. Needs restart for run-sql recording.

features.name: Per-schema document RAG indexer
features.detail: Extracts + chunks documents from a profile's Documents/ folder into a searchable index.json; supports txt/md/csv/docx/pdf/spk/expk/xml/json with graceful fallbacks.

features.name: Document & config import endpoints
features.detail: Upload / URL / config-package ingestion that also fire enrich.py best-effort to refresh the affected layers.

features.name: Control-panel launcher
features.detail: Self-elevating menu; auto-detects SERVICE mode (QI_MapSnap + QI_MapSnapTunnel via NSSM) vs MANUAL mode (local Python + Cloudflare quick tunnel).

features.name: Named tunnel service installer
features.detail: Registers QI_MapSnapTunnel; guards against clobbering the centrally-managed named tunnel (mapsnap.quiddityinnovations.com) unless --force.

features.name: Browser rebuild helper
features.detail: Regenerates schema_browser.html from the current schema.json without a full re-extract.

features.name: QI Hive Project Status page
features.detail: This documentation set, rendered by C:\QIH\engine\hive\dashboard\project_status.py.
